capacity: ARC Mutants team member and The ARC Daily Digest head human editor
status: Participant confirmation; corroborated by the dated public rosters published alongside this note.
statement: Jack Cole has joined Mark Barney, Son Pham and Ronen for ARC-AGI-2. The ARC-AGI-2 team is ARC Mutants (team 17023174). It is a separate competition entry from Team Turducken (ARC-AGI-3 team 15605182). Jack joining ARC Mutants does not announce his joining Team Turducken. Mark says the combined ARC2 effort is aiming for gold.
directQuotes: We've acquired our own Professor X and are honored to have Jack Cole join us.
He's a true legend of ARC and we're hoping that our combined efforts in ARC2 can take us to gold.
artwork: Mark approved the ARC Mutants digital-academy illustration in the commissioning conversation. Jack, Mark and Son use their established character references; Ronen is represented by an original helmeted character, not a verified human likeness. All powers, costumes and hardware are editorial fantasy.
